GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

3. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.

5. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   C. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

8. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   C. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   D. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

10. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   B. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   D. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   D. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   D. Treat Mining as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

16. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   B. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
